# The Dressing Room of Fashion - Copilot Instructions

This project is a trendy outfit selection web application for Gen-Z and Gen-Alpha teens.

## Project Overview
- **Name**: The Dressing Room of Fashion
- **Purpose**: Web interface for selecting trendy outfits based on style profiles
- **Target Audience**: Teens (Gen-Z and Gen-Alpha)
- **Components**: Tops, bottoms, shoes, and accessories selection

## Development Guidelines
- Focus on modern, trendy fashion items popular with teens
- Use contemporary web technologies (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript)
- Implement responsive design for mobile-first experience
- Include popular teen fashion trends and aesthetics
- Create intuitive style profile system

## Fashion Categories to Include
- **Tops**: Crop tops, oversized hoodies, graphic tees, corsets, mesh tops
- **Bottoms**: Baggy jeans, cargo pants, mini skirts, bike shorts, wide-leg pants
- **Shoes**: Chunky sneakers, platform boots, Converse, Doc Martens, Crocs
- **Accessories**: Layered jewelry, bucket hats, hair clips, phone cases, tote bags

## Style Profiles
- Y2K Aesthetic
- Dark Academia
- Cottagecore
- Streetwear
- VSCO Girl
- E-Girl/E-Boy
- Minimalist
- Grunge
